page.layout: One printed page, single text column in the centre; running head with page number at the top; no notes in the margins. A cropped fragment of the facing page lies at the right edge and is not transcribed. Scanner's banner at the foot is excluded.

main_text.p: ditur, alibi risus, alibi disparata nec intellecta responsio. Videtur proinde communem illam calamitatem, in qua cuncti nascimur, feliciter à se depulisse, qui in capaci memoriâ plurimarum gentium repositit idiomata: Ubique inter suos est, omne solum ei patria: nusquam familiaribus intercænam sermonibus accumbit caperatâ fronte mutus auditor : nusquam viam scifcitaturus, mutilis mixtisque vocabulis cachinnum movet accolæ: nusquam inter ridentium fales suspiciosus,quid sibi velint, in aurem insusurrat interpreti. Ad hæc, magnum omnino confert bene regendæ Reipublicæ momentum, confinium populorum, sociorum, hostium noviffe mores & genium; Atqui ista ex solo etiam idiomate non vanè conjiciet peritus rerum æstimator:
main_text.notes: Page is clean apart from the cropped facing page at the right edge. Reading of "repositit" is a probable misprint for "reposuit"; left as printed in the scan, marked as doubtful. "scifcitaturus" reads as printed (probably "scifcitaturus" for "scisciturus"); "fales" and "fales" as printed. Catchword and signature not visible.
